name: retention-max
label: Retention-max (MrBeast-style)
description: Promise-matched cold open, stakes in 5 s, stair-step escalation with re-engagement spikes, abrupt end. 2024 style lets scenes breathe (~23 cuts/min long-form).

sync.broll: scale wides, drone, prize/number inserts on every stake or number word, 0.5-2 s, ~70:30 A:B, full-frame
sync.fillers: reaction cutaways every few cuts, snap zooms on punchlines, timer/number cards; interrupt every 3-5 s (Shorts)
sync.music: continuous upbeat cue that switches per segment; 0.5-1 s drop-out before each reveal then impact; montages on the beat
sync.emotion_map: curiosity → awe → investment → tension (ticking, drones) → spike (riser+hit) → triumph → abrupt cut
sync.transitions: hard cuts, whip/zoom between segments, 'Day 3' time-skip cards

evidence: high for structure (production memo, measured cuts/min); captions/SFX est.
compliance_lock: health brands: no prizes/giveaways (inducements), no superlatives
